description: Elections Commission - A. C. P. Athukorala and H. M. D. Herath of the Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral matters under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, declaring that two members of the Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of their political party. This falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral processes, specifically the vacation of office by elected local government officials.
